text:
Sam: Nightly integ run just went red across multiple shards against Hosted API — looks like auth handshake + streaming ordering + tool-call schema tests all failing.
Priya: Ugh, which tests specifically?
Sam: test_toolcall_auth_flow, test_streaming_chunk_ordering, test_tool_schema_validation are the top hits. Failing errors look like 401s and malformed tool payloads.
Sam: Log snippet: ```ERROR hosted-api: auth: token validation failed: kid mismatch\nstream: unexpected EOF while reading chunk\ntoolcall: schema mismatch: missing 'tool_id' field``` 
Max: I kicked off a quick reproduce in staging, getting same 401s on the Hosted API smoke-targets. Could be jwks rotation or a header change.
Laura: Any recent changes to token handling or the auth proxy? I saw a small PR landed this morning touching auth proxy header passthrough (PR #1428) — rolling that back for a quick run might help.
dev-bot: nightly-integrations: run 2026-03-17T05:02Z -> 14 failures on shards [3,7,12], failing suite: hosted-integ-smoke
Priya: Can someone bisect to the merge window? If PR #1428 is suspect, we can try a revert on staging and rerun shard-3.
Rick: I can do the bisect. Which command is preferred? `./ci/rerun.sh --shard 3 --suite hosted-integ-smoke --branch staging` ?
Max: Yep that's the one. Also check headers on the proxy: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://hosted-api.internal/_health` and inspect jwks kid in the token vs the proxy jwks cache.
Sam: Reproduced curl shows token kid is 0x7a3 but proxy jwks has 0x6f2. That explains kid mismatch 401s.
Laura: PR #1428 added caching for JWKS with a 1h TTL to reduce overhead — maybe a race where rotation happened. I'll open a quick revert PR and tag infra.
dev-bot: CI: queued rerun for shard 3 on revert branch (rerun id 9982)
Priya: If rerun still fails, let's bisect between the last green and current HEAD. @Rick can you run parallel bisect on shards 3 and 7 tomorrow morning? 
Rick: Yep, will start at 09:00 PT and post results here. If it's JWKS TTL, short-term patch: lower TTL to 15s and add a backfill fetch on 401.
Max: For streaming/toolcall schema errors: looks like a downstream serializer changed ordering of optional fields in PR #1429 (not merged yet?) but a canary slipped into staging via shared lib. Checking now.
Sam: Ok plan: Laura revert JWKS caching change -> rerun shard 3. Rick bisect tomorrow if still red. Max to audit serializer lib for accidental publish. Priya to coordinate with SRE for hotfix if revert fixes it.
Laura: Revert PR open -> #1432, request: @eng-infra review asap.
ops-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0317-1 - Nightly integ smoke failures vs Hosted API (auth/stream/toolcall). Assigned to eng-sre.
Sam: Thanks folks, will follow up with results. :thumbsup:
